# TRENDING ON THE RELAY [italic]The most rewound tapes this relay cycle. Charts are six weeks behind the Core and three weeks ahead of the Outer Veil.[/italic]
## 1. Marine Tries To Explain His Tattoo by dropship_dad. 911,004 rewinds. He has a tattoo of a skull with a beret on. He says it has a meaning. Eight minutes later he is still working on it.
[color=#9A9A9A]Top comment, seeker_of_the_veil: the beret is on the wrong side. that is how you know it is real[/color]
## 2. Chroma Sleep, Neon Over Titan (live, from row 40) by methane_kid_88. 740,212 rewinds. Shot on a camcorder held above a crowd for the whole song. You cannot see the band. You can hear four thousand people sing the chorus. It is the best tape on YouTape.
## 3. My Working Joe Learns To Wave by hydro_hannah. 603,377 rewinds. It took three weeks. It is a very slow wave. The Joe has been waving since the tape was made and Seegson support has been asked how to make it stop.
## 4. Weather Report But It Is Just A Man Looking Out A Window by AtmoCast_unofficial. 412,890 rewinds. Better than the real one, according to the comments. For the real one, see [netlink="AtmoCast" link="atmocast.wx"].
## 5. Something In The Background At Minute Four by birthday_tapes_lena. 388,011 rewinds. A child's fifth birthday in a colony canteen. At minute four, top left, behind the cake, something moves along the ceiling. The family have asked people to stop sending them letters and to enjoy the cake.
[color=#9A9A9A]This tape has been flagged for review by the Company. It is still trending.[/color]
## 6. Ten Hours Of Static by uploader_unknown. 0 rewinds. Nobody has rewound it. It is on the chart anyway. It was not sent to the sorting office. It was already in the library when we opened this morning.
